findings.text: All 67 empty promoted JSON records omit content (not an explicit empty string). Each has a substantive adjacent raw MD; promoted MD Content sections are all empty. No genuinely body-less source was found.
66 metadata-only records are July 15; the selected Atrybuty test v2 metadata-only record is July 17. Raw MD formats include 50 business-description layouts and 17 classification/table/API layouts.

66 affected titles have newer July 17 selected JSON-content counterparts; 62 have identical trimmed body hashes, 4 differ. All 190 staged chunks map to actual selected draft sourcePath and entityRefId; all five CSV datasets match actual exporter reconstruction exactly.

Actual promoteDraft omits adjacent MD fallback. The isolated fixture reproduces empty JSON/MD snapshots; force retries the same bug. Raw MD remains intact and two audit events are confined to fixture ROOT, removed in finally.

Current staged/local-search corpus is protected by the selected JSON bodies (189 chunks) and one exporter MD fallback chunk. Repairing snapshots at promotion without altering raw selection should not require an export or build to repair this snapshot defect.

Exporter selection is raw-based and registry-status-blind. Current OWA registry entries are all promoted, so there is no observed pending/withdrawn selection in this corpus today. Future admission of such drafts is a separate code-path risk, not an instruction to change ingestion.

Current live graph contents, embedding parity, source correctness and current MSSQL claims are not tested. Retrieval ranking defects seen in tool outputs are not causally attributed to the empty snapshots.

recommendation.minimalNamespaceLimitedFallback: In promoteDraft, only for OWAOntology and missing/blank JSON content, read that exact draft’s adjacent rawMarkdownPath and retain its substantive ontology body as promoted.content. Prefer JSON when nonempty; preserve raw JSON and raw MD byte-for-byte. Keep this out of findRawDrafts so length-first version selection is unchanged.
recommendation.rehydration: After approved implementation and tests, back up each exact promoted JSON/MD pair plus complete registry state and provenance/hashes; rehydrate only these 67 snapshots through the supported promoteDraft force path (manage_knowledge_inbox promote <exactId> --force), namespace and expected-hash checked. No export/build/graph cleanup is indicated for the snapshot-only repair.

recommendation.supportedPathLimitation: Bare existing force is not preservation-safe: it always replaces promotedAt with now, defaults/replaces promotedBy and reviewNote, and replaces the entire registry entry with a fixed field set. Existing --by/--note can carry operator/note but there is no original-date or complete-entry preservation option. An approved namespace-scoped preservation design in the supported helper path is required before executing repair; do not silently call bare --force or manually edit snapshots/registry.

nonempty JSON remains preferred even when MD differs
missing or genuinely empty MD blocks loss-producing repair
